verdict.rationale: Unleash's own Change Requests feature lets you require an additional approval step before any change can be made in a chosen environment, such as production. You can require up to 10 approvals, and approved changes can be grouped and scheduled to apply at a set time. The GitHub README lists change requests as a feature of the hosted offering, so the capability may be tier-gated. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the approval gating works as documented, and documentation of who can approve (approver roles, self-approval rules) and of plan/tier availability.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can require approvals or change requests before production flag changes go live

citations.quote: Change requests allow you to require an additional approval step before any changes can be made in an environment.
You can require up to 10 approvals for a change request.
Change requests also allow you to group changes and apply them at a specific point in time.
This allows you to enable a flag in development or test without enabling it in production.
features such as role-based access control, change requests, single sign-on, and SCIM
